notes: Standing under Section 35 requires satisfying the Section 2(7) consumer definition and commercial-purpose exclusion.
District Commission complaints under Section 35 are subject to the two-year limitation period under Section 69.
Section 39 remedies depend on establishing defect or deficiency under Section 2(10)-(11).
G.S.R. 912(E) lowered District Commission pecuniary threshold from Rs. 1 crore to Rs. 50 lakh.
G.S.R. 606(E) substituted the Rule 7(2) fee table effective 17 August 2023.
CPA 2019 replaced CPA 1986 effective 20 July 2020 subject to Section 107 savings.
Pre-1 July 2024 cheating offences remain under IPC Section 420 via BNS Section 358 savings; on/after 1 July 2024 use BNS Section 318.
Pending pre-1 July 2024 proceedings continue under CrPC 1973 via BNSS Section 531(2)(a); new FIRs follow BNSS Section 173.
Zero-liability protection under Para 6 must be read with Para 7 customer-negligence exception (sharing credentials/OTP).
RB-IOS 2021 integrated BOS 2006, NBFC Ombudsman 2018, and Digital Transactions Ombudsman 2019 w.e.f. 12 Nov 2021.
